column1: Picture: a blanket-clutching boy sitting alone in a moonlit pumpkin patch at night, waiting, while a girl in a coat sits next to him.

column1: In what year did It's the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown first air, and on which network?
column2: 1966, on CBS. Charles Schulz wrote it, Bill Melendez directed it, and Vince Guaraldi did the music.

column1: In It's the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown, what does Linus believe the Great Pumpkin does?
column2: He believes the Great Pumpkin rises out of the most "sincere" pumpkin patch on Halloween night and brings toys to children. Linus writes him a letter every year.

column1: "I got a rock." Who says it, and in what special?
column2: Charlie Brown, every time he is given a treat while trick-or-treating, in It's the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown (1966).

column1: Picture: a beagle in a WWI flying helmet and goggles, sitting on top of his doghouse as if it were a plane, in a Halloween special.
column2: Snoopy as the World War I Flying Ace, fighting the Red Baron, in It's the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown.

column1: Picture: a glittering round orange-and-gold carriage shaped like a pumpkin, pulled by white horses, with a fairy godmother waving a wand.

column1: At what time does Cinderella's coach turn back into a pumpkin?
column2: At the stroke of midnight. The pumpkin was introduced in Charles Perrault's 1697 version of the story.

column1: Picture: a 19th-century painting of a black-cloaked rider with no head, galloping on a black horse after a lanky schoolmaster through a dark forest.

column1: Who wrote The Legend of Sleepy Hollow, and in what collection was it published?
column2: Washington Irving. It appeared in The Sketch Book of Geoffrey Crayon, Gent. (1820).

column1: In The Legend of Sleepy Hollow, what does the Headless Horseman throw at Ichabod Crane at the bridge, and who is the suspected prankster?

column1: Picture: an animated cartoon of a black horseman holding up a flaming, cackling jack-o'-lantern while a skinny man on a plow horse flees.

column1: Who directed the 1999 film Sleepy Hollow, and who played Ichabod Crane and the Horseman?
column2: Tim Burton directed it. Johnny Depp played Ichabod Crane, here a New York constable, and Christopher Walken played the Hessian Horseman.

column1: Picture: a hulking, gray-brown, spindly demon with a large bulbous head, long fingers and a curved spine, stalking through a foggy rural night. It is also the title of a 1988 horror film.

column1: In Pumpkinhead (1988), who summons the demon, and why?
column2: Ed Harley, played by Lance Henriksen, has a witch summon it to take revenge on the teenagers who killed his young son by accident. The demon is dug up from a pumpkin patch graveyard.

column1: Picture: a book illustration of a gangly figure with a stick-and-wooden body and a carved jack-o'-lantern for a head, wearing a pink shirt and a vest.
column2: Jack Pumpkinhead, from L. Frank Baum's The Marvelous Land of Oz (1904).

column1: In the Oz books, who built Jack Pumpkinhead, and how did he come to life?
column2: The boy Tip built him, and Tip is later revealed to be Princess Ozma. The witch Mombi brought him to life with the Powder of Life.

column1: Which 1985 Disney film brought Jack Pumpkinhead to the screen alongside Tik-Tok and the Gump?
column2: Return to Oz (1985), starring Fairuza Balk as Dorothy.

column1: Picture: a small child in orange footie pajamas with a burlap sack over his head that has button eyes and a stitched mouth, carrying a lollipop.

column1: In Trick 'r Treat, which grumpy old man, played by Brian Cox, gets a visit from Sam?
column2: Mr. Kreeg, a Halloween-hating hermit who won't hand out candy.

column1: Picture: black screen, opening credits in orange letters, and a lit jack-o'-lantern with a jagged grin as the camera slowly pushes in toward its eye. 1978.

column1: Picture: a green-suited villain on a bat-shaped glider, lobbing small orange jack-o'-lantern grenades.
column2: The Green Goblin, Spider-Man's arch-enemy (Norman Osborn), with his trademark pumpkin bombs.

column1: Picture: a cartoon of two brothers, one in a cape and a pointy red hat, in a village of skeleton-like people wearing pumpkin costumes, in an autumn-toned animated miniseries.

column1: Picture: a video game villager with a lit jack-o'-lantern for a head, a purple cape, and a candy-demanding attitude on October 31.
